name: 1000 Words
source:
Inspired by a true story of a family friend; he was in a hospital and this really great nurse named Susan took care of him. Later he asked if he could speak to Susan after he got out of the hospital and they told him none of their nurses were named Susan; he thinks she was an angel.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161208201258/http://vera-san.deviantart.com/art/1000-Words-A-Visual-Novel-209573936]Wayback Machine[/url]]
translation:
灵感来自一位家庭友人的真实经历。他住院时，一位名叫苏珊的护士悉心照料他。出院后，他想再和苏珊说说话，却被告知医院里没有任何护士叫苏珊。他觉得，她或许是一位天使。
